fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 90 days after the date you arrive.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de caducidad al menos 90 días posterior a la fecha de llegada.
entry.quote: To enter Israel or Palestine, your passport must have an ‘expiry date’ at least 90 days after the date you arrive.

entry.en: You can visit Israel without a visa as a tourist and get permission to stay up to 3 months on entry.
entry.es: Se puede visitar Israel sin visado como turista y se obtiene permiso para quedarse hasta 3 meses al entrar.
entry.quote: You can visit Israel without a visa as a tourist. On entry, visitors get permission to stay for up to 3 months.

entry.en: As of 1 January 2025 visitors need an Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) before arrival, valid 2 years, covering 90 days and costing 25 new Israeli shekels.
entry.es: Desde el 1 de enero de 2025 los visitantes necesitan una autorización electrónica de viaje (ETA) antes de llegar, válida 2 años, para 90 días y con un coste de 25 nuevos shéqueles.
entry.quote: As of 1 January 2025, to visit Israel you will need to get an Electronic Travel Authorisation (ETA) before you arrive. The ETA is valid for 2 years and covers a visit of 90 days. It will cost 25 new Israeli shekels.

entry.en: Visitors entering via Tel Aviv Ben Gurion Airport get an entry card instead of a passport stamp, and should keep it with their passport until they leave.
entry.es: Quienes entran por el aeropuerto Ben Gurión de Tel Aviv reciben una tarjeta de entrada en lugar de un sello y deben conservarla con el pasaporte hasta salir.
entry.quote: Visitors entering via Tel Aviv Ben Gurion Airport get an entry card instead of an entry stamp in their passport.

entry.en: You may experience lengthy personal questioning and baggage searches at security when you enter and leave Israel.
entry.es: Puede haber interrogatorios personales largos y registros de equipaje de seguridad al entrar y salir de Israel.
entry.quote: You may experience lengthy personal questioning and baggage searches at security when you enter and leave Israel.

entry.en: Children aged 17 and under travelling alone or with one parent should carry a letter from their parents or guardians confirming consent, accommodation plans and contact details.
entry.es: Los menores de 17 años o menos que viajan solos o con un solo progenitor deben llevar una carta de sus padres o tutores que confirme el consentimiento, el alojamiento y los datos de contacto.
entry.quote: Children aged 17 and under travelling to Israel alone or with only one parent should carry a letter from their parents or guardians confirming parental consent, accommodation plans and contact details.

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel to Gaza.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a Gaza.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel to Gaza

safety.en: FCDO advises against all travel within 500m of the border with Gaza.
safety.es: El FCDO desaconseja todo viaje a menos de 500 m de la frontera con Gaza.
safety.quote: FCDO advises against all travel within 500m of the border with Gaza

safety.en: There is a risk of rocket and drone attacks throughout Israel, and of shrapnel from intercepted missiles.
safety.es: Existe riesgo de ataques con cohetes y drones en todo Israel, y de metralla de misiles interceptados.
safety.quote: there is a risk of rocket and drone attacks throughout Israel. There is a risk of shrapnel from intercepted missiles falling across Israel and Palestine

safety.en: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Israel and Palestine.
safety.es: Es muy probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Israel y Palestina.
safety.quote: Terrorists are very likely to try to carry out attacks in Israel and Palestine.

safety.en: Theft of passports, credit cards and valuables from public beaches is common.
safety.es: Es común el robo de pasaportes, tarjetas de crédito y objetos de valor en playas públicas.
safety.quote: Theft of passports, credit cards, and valuables from public beaches is common.

safety.en: In Jerusalem, the West Bank and Gaza, clothing should cover your shoulders, upper arms, and legs above the knee.
safety.es: En Jerusalén, Cisjordania y Gaza, la ropa debe cubrir los hombros, la parte superior de los brazos y las piernas por encima de la rodilla.
safety.quote: In Jerusalem, the West Bank and Gaza, clothing should cover your shoulders, upper arms, and legs above the knee.

health.en: Healthcare is not free, treatment can be expensive and hospitals will insist on payment, so adequate travel health insurance is needed.
health.es: La atención médica no es gratuita, el tratamiento puede ser caro y los hospitales exigirán el pago, por lo que se necesita un seguro médico de viaje adecuado.
health.quote: Healthcare in Israel and Palestine is not free and medical treatment can be expensive. Hospitals will insist on payment

health.en: No immunizations are required for entry, though a hepatitis A vaccine is recommended.
health.es: No se exige ninguna vacuna para entrar, aunque se recomienda la de la hepatitis A.
health.quote: no immunizations are required for entry. A hepatitis A vaccine is recommended, though.

health.en: Tap water is potable throughout Israel, but not in the West Bank or Gaza.
health.es: El agua del grifo es potable en todo Israel, pero no en Cisjordania ni en Gaza.
health.quote: Tap water is potable and perfectly safe for drinking all throughout Israel (but not in the West Bank or Gaza)

health.en: Pharmacists and all medical personnel speak adequate English.
health.es: Los farmacéuticos y todo el personal médico hablan inglés adecuado.
health.quote: Pharmacists and all medical personnel speak adequate English.

health.en: The hot climate is a major issue, especially in summer, so use sunscreen and drink a lot of water.
health.es: El clima caluroso es un problema importante, sobre todo en verano, por lo que se recomienda usar protector solar y beber mucha agua.
health.quote: The hot climate in Israel is a major issue, especially in summer. Use sunscreen throughout your stay and drink a lot of water.

help.en: Emergency numbers are ambulance 101, fire 102 and police 100.
help.es: Los números de emergencia son ambulancia 101, bomberos 102 y policía 100.

help.en: For an ambulance dial 100 in Israel and 101 in the West Bank and Gaza.
help.es: Para una ambulancia se marca el 100 en Israel y el 101 en Cisjordania y Gaza.
help.quote:
For an ambulance dial:

- 100 in Israel

- 101 in the West Bank and Gaza

help.en: You can call FCDO in London on 020 7008 5000, 24 hours, for urgent help about a friend or relative abroad.
help.es: Se puede llamar al FCDO en Londres al 020 7008 5000, las 24 horas, para ayuda urgente por un amigo o familiar en el extranjero.
help.quote: You can call FCDO in London if you need urgent help because something has happened to a friend or relative abroad.

help.en: The Home Front Command can be reached by calling 104 in Israel.
help.es: Se puede contactar con el Mando del Frente Interno llamando al 104 en Israel.
help.quote: call 104 if you are in Israel

getting_in.en: Ben Gurion International Airport (TLV) is Israel's main international airport, about 20 km southeast of Tel Aviv and 45 km northwest of Jerusalem.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto internacional Ben Gurión (TLV) es el principal de Israel, a unos 20 km al sureste de Tel Aviv y 45 km al noroeste de Jerusalén.
getting_in.quote: Israel's main international airport. Located on the outskirts of Lod, it is about 20 km (12 mi) southeast of Tel Aviv and about 45 km (28 mi) northwest of Jerusalem.

getting_in.en: Ramon Airport, 20 km north of Eilat, handles all flights to Eilat.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto Ramon, a 20 km al norte de Eilat, gestiona todos los vuelos a Eilat.
getting_in.quote: This airport opened in 2019, and now handles all flights to Eilat.

getting_in.en: Haifa Airport has a daily flight from Athens and several daily flights from Larnaca as of early 2025.
getting_in.es: A principios de 2025 el aeropuerto de Haifa tiene un vuelo diario desde Atenas y varios diarios desde Larnaca.
getting_in.quote: As of early 2025, this airport is operated by Air Haifa with a daily flight from Athens and several daily flights from Larnaca.

getting_in.en: Flights on Israeli airlines face additional security measures at departure, including intensive questioning at check-in.
getting_in.es: Los vuelos de aerolíneas israelíes tienen medidas de seguridad adicionales en la salida, incluido un interrogatorio intensivo en el check-in.
getting_in.quote: Flights to Israel on Israeli airlines are subject to additional security measures at their points of departure. This means that you will be subject to intensive questioning at check-in

getting_in.en: The Jordan crossings are Allenby/King Hussein Bridge, the Northern (Jordan River/Sheikh Hussein) and the Southern (Yitzhak Rabin/Wadi Araba).
getting_in.es: Los pasos con Jordania son el puente Allenby/Rey Hussein, el del norte (río Jordán/Sheikh Hussein) y el del sur (Yitzhak Rabin/Wadi Araba).
getting_in.quote:
Allenby/King Hussein Bridge 

- 
The Northern (Jordan River/Sheikh Hussein) crossing 

- 
The Southern (Yitzhak Rabin/Wadi Araba) crossing

getting_in.en: The Taba crossing to Egypt is open 24 hours, with opening times subject to change.
getting_in.es: El paso de Taba a Egipto está abierto las 24 horas, con horarios sujetos a cambios.
getting_in.quote:
Egypt-Israel border crossing (opening times are subject to change): 

- Taba: Open 24 hours

getting_around.en: Public transport stops from Friday 16:00 until Saturday evening for Shabbat, except in Nazareth, Haifa, East Jerusalem and Eilat.
getting_around.es: El transporte público se detiene desde el viernes a las 16:00 hasta el sábado por la tarde por el Shabat, salvo en Nazaret, Haifa, Jerusalén Este y Eilat.
getting_around.quote: With the exception of Nazareth, Haifa, East Jerusalem and Eilat, public transport services are completely stopped.

getting_around.en: Buses are the cheapest way to get around Israel and are described as safe and reliable.
getting_around.es: Los autobuses son la forma más barata de moverse por Israel y se describen como seguros y fiables.
getting_around.quote: Bus travel is the cheapest way to get around Israel, and is safe and reliable.

getting_around.en: The train network reaches most main cities and Ben Gurion Airport, but trains do not run from Friday afternoon until Saturday evening.
getting_around.es: La red ferroviaria llega a las principales ciudades y al aeropuerto Ben Gurión, pero no hay trenes desde el viernes por la tarde hasta el sábado por la noche.
getting_around.quote: Israel's train network reaches most of the main cities as well as Ben Gurion Airport, the main entry point for foreign visitors.

getting_around.en: The taxi driver should use the meter (moneh), and some drivers try to scam tourists by not turning it on.
getting_around.es: El taxista debe usar el taxímetro (moneh), y algunos conductores intentan estafar a turistas sin encenderlo.
getting_around.quote: Drivers are known to try to scam tourists by not turning on the meter to begin with and then fighting about the cost at the end of the ride.

getting_around.en: Gett is a local ridehailing option, and Uber also works in Tel Aviv.
getting_around.es: Gett es una opción local de transporte con aplicación, y Uber también funciona en Tel Aviv.
getting_around.quote: Ridehailing is available in Israel. Gett is a local option, Uber works also in Tel Aviv

getting_around.en: FCDO advises against using taxis in the West Bank because of their involvement in a significant number of accidents.
getting_around.es: El FCDO desaconseja usar taxis en Cisjordania por su implicación en un número significativo de accidentes.
getting_around.quote: We advise you not to use taxis in the West Bank, because of their involvement in a significant number of accidents.

money.en: Israel's currency is the New Israeli Shekel, denoted by the symbol ₪.
money.es: La moneda de Israel es el nuevo shéquel israelí, representado con el símbolo ₪.
money.quote: Israel's currency is the New Israeli Shekel (שקל חדש or ש"ח), which is often known simply as the Shekel.

money.en: Contactless mobile and card payments are widely accepted and commonly used.
money.es: Los pagos sin contacto con móvil y tarjeta están ampliamente aceptados y son de uso común.
money.quote: Contactless mobile/card payments with Google Pay, Apple Pay, Visa, MasterCard, American Express, and Discover are widely accepted and commonly used.

money.en: ATMs are available everywhere, and some charge usage fees that are displayed.
money.es: Hay cajeros automáticos en todas partes y algunos cobran comisiones que se muestran.
money.quote: ATMs are available everywhere. Some ATMs have usage fees (they are displayed).

money.en: VAT refunds are only granted for individual receipts in excess of ₪400 and subject to other conditions.
money.es: Los reembolsos del IVA solo se conceden por recibos individuales superiores a 400 ₪ y sujetos a otras condiciones.
money.quote: VAT refunds are only granted for individual receipts in excess of ₪400 and subject to a few other conditions.

money.en: The norm for waiters is a 15% tip, but Israelis do not tip taxi drivers.
money.es: La norma para los camareros es una propina del 15 %, pero los israelíes no dan propina a los taxistas.
money.quote: The norm for waiters is a 15% tip unless the service was horribly disrespectful.

money.en: Israel is expensive, with prices similar to the upper end of western and northern Europe.
money.es: Israel es caro, con precios similares a los más altos de Europa occidental y septentrional.
money.quote: Israel is expensive. Prices are similar to the upper end prices of western and northern Europe.

etiquette.en: Entry to most religious sites is refused to those not dressed appropriately, such as in shorts, short skirts or tank tops.
etiquette.es: Se niega la entrada a la mayoría de los sitios religiosos a quienes no vistan adecuadamente, por ejemplo con pantalones cortos, minifaldas o camisetas sin mangas.
etiquette.quote: Entry to most religious sites will be refused to those who aren't dressed appropriately (e.g. wearing shorts, short skirts, tank tops, and so on).

etiquette.en: Men should cover their heads at a synagogue or the prayers section of the Western Wall, and mosques require removing shoes.
etiquette.es: Los hombres deben cubrirse la cabeza en una sinagoga o en la zona de oración del Muro de las Lamentaciones, y las mezquitas exigen quitarse los zapatos.
etiquette.quote: When visiting a synagogue or the prayers section of the Western Wall, men should cover their heads.

etiquette.en: Israelis in general are direct communicators, which can seem rude or abrupt elsewhere.
etiquette.es: Los israelíes en general se comunican de forma directa, lo que en otros lugares puede parecer descortés o brusco.
etiquette.quote: Israelis in general are direct communicators.

etiquette.en: Wearing shorts or sleeveless shirts is not recommended in Haredi neighborhoods, and entering them with vehicles on the Sabbath is forbidden.
etiquette.es: No se recomienda entrar en barrios jaredíes con pantalones cortos o sin mangas, y en Shabat está prohibido entrar con vehículos.
etiquette.quote: it is recommended not to enter with shorts or sleeveless shirts (especially for women). During the Jewish Sabbath, it is forbidden to enter their neighborhoods with vehicles at all

etiquette.en: Israeli politics is a sensitive subject and talking about it is very emotional among Israelis.
etiquette.es: La política israelí es un tema delicado y hablar de ella resulta muy emotivo entre los israelíes.
etiquette.quote: Israeli politics is a sensitive subject

etiquette.en: During Ramadan, FCDO says not to eat, drink, smoke or chew gum in public in the daytime if in Palestine.
etiquette.es: Durante el Ramadán, el FCDO indica no comer, beber, fumar ni mascar chicle en público de día si se está en Palestina.
etiquette.quote: eat, drink, smoke or chew gum in public in the daytime, including in your car

connectivity.en: Israel is mostly covered with 4G and 5G, and VoLTE should be enabled.
connectivity.es: Israel tiene cobertura mayoritariamente 4G y 5G, y se debe tener VoLTE activado.
connectivity.quote: Israel is mostly covered with 4G and 5G, but make sure to have VoLTE enabled.

connectivity.en: Buying a local SIM card is easy from many phone kiosks near popular tourist sites.
connectivity.es: Comprar una tarjeta SIM local es fácil en muchos quioscos de telefonía cerca de sitios turísticos populares.
connectivity.quote: Buying a local SIM card is easy from many phone kiosks near popular tourist sites

connectivity.en: eSIM service is available through all local providers and through SkyCall.
connectivity.es: El servicio eSIM está disponible con todos los proveedores locales y con SkyCall.
connectivity.quote: eSim service is available through all local provides and through SkyCall.

connectivity.en: Local prepaid packages valid for a month with 300G of data and 2,000 minutes should cost less than ₪100.
connectivity.es: Los paquetes locales de prepago válidos por un mes con 300 GB de datos y 2000 minutos deberían costar menos de 100 ₪.
connectivity.quote: Local prepaid packages valid for a month with 300G of data and 2,000 minutes of local calls should cost less than ₪100.
